about: Held-out paraphrases of RMD V2 acceptance cases, written on 2026-11-05 before any retrieval change and not used to tune it. Each question avoids the source's key terms where it can. A case passes when one of the top 5 passages (acceptance sections excluded) is in an expected section.

cases.q: How much of the final mark do the solo and team assignments carry?
Which 75th percentile delivery days did the group set for each Brazilian state in the trial?
If the buffer left is exactly the same as the benchmark, does the order get flagged?
List the twelve requirements the team agreed in the deck.
How many automated checks ran in the workflow and did the count change between versions?
Does the share of flagged parcels that arrived late measure how accurate the warning is?
Do the orders the pilot would protect prove it pays for itself?
Are the helpdesk software subscription costs up to date?
The file has no empty cells and no repeated record numbers, so can we trust it completely?
Show how one pump wore out over three years and when it will break next.
What share of jobs were finished within the agreed service time?
Why do two reports give slightly different uptime percentages?
What is the average running time between breakdowns across the fleet?
How much money did condition-based upkeep save us?
This year shows fewer breakdowns and lower spending; is that real progress?
Can we reuse the trained classifier and its reported area under the curve?
